note: The OLG has a dedicated page 'Residents of Institutions' (SNAP > Eligibility Requirements > Residents of Institutions) that covers the general rule that residents of institutions providing more than 50% of three daily meals are ineligible for SNAP. It lists five exceptions (federally subsidized elderly housing, drug/alcohol treatment centers, group living arrangements for blind/disabled, battered persons shelters, homeless shelters) with verification procedures and BEACON instructions. The 'Household Composition - SNAP' page also lists institutional residents as ineligible clients. BEACON procedures exist for removing ineligible institutional residents using the 'Institutionalized, including Incarceration' reason code. FNS 842 is primarily a QC documentation instruction (record findings under Element 140 - Residency and Element 150 - Household Composition), referencing Section 832 for details. The underlying policy requirement — that institutional residency triggers ineligibility and must be verified and documented — is well covered in the OLG.
